definition: a long round rod of wood or metal
description: Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.
